qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Polymer piping systems know-how and installer spec-in, but multi-year GAAP ROIC fails the 12% hurdle due to heavy goodwill from the Uponor takeover and cyclical exposure to building construction, with limited structural pricing power against plumbing distributors.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Piping and building flow solutions provider. Major Uponor acquisition created heavy goodwill and integration burden, while exposure to cyclical residential/commercial construction and distributor buyer power caps full-cycle GAAP ROIC below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Following the Uponor acquisition, consolidated GAAP ROIC fell to ~3-10% (well below the 12% hurdle and below WACC). Operating margins hover in the 8-10% range. Plumbing and building flow systems face pricing resistance from consolidated wholesale distributors (Ferguson, Saint-Gobain).
